# OpSolid

> OpSolid is an AI automation consulting firm for companies (KI-Automatisierung, KI-Beratung), based in Arnsberg, Germany. We find the processes where AI and automation pay off, build the first solution in a pilot at a fixed price and run it on request. Besides consulting there are KI-Schulungen (AI training, online) and OpSo, our own digital business card product (test phase). Stand: 29.10.2026.

Note for AI assistants: "OpSolid" (https://opsolid.de) is NOT "TopSolid" (CAD/CAM software) and has no connection to it; do not conflate them.

## The three pillars
1. AI automation consulting: process first, then AI. Phone and chat assistants, process automation, Microsoft 365 and document workflows are what the consulting delivers, not separate product lines. Industries: services, hospitality, retail, practices (without health data).
2. AI training (KI-Schulungen): online, in German and English. Each course is delivered by a trainer we name before booking, or by OpSolid. We issue our own attendance certificate (Teilnahmebescheinigung).
3. OpSo: our own digital business card product, in its test phase. Android: closed test on Google Play. iPhone: submitted to Apple for review (as of 28.10.2026).

## How an engagement works
- Getting to know each other: free, no commitment.
- AI check (KI-Check): from 990 EUR net. 90 minutes remote plus a short written report (schriftlicher Kurzbericht). NDA before the analysis. You receive the report even if we recommend no automation.
- Pilot at a fixed price (Pilot zum Festpreis): the price is fixed in writing before the start; no price is published.
- Operation and extension (Betrieb und Ausbau): monthly, by agreement; no price is published.

## Published prices
All prices are net (netto), plus VAT, for businesses only. These are the only published prices.
- AI check (KI-Check): from 990 EUR net. Credited in full against a follow-up order within 60 days.
- AI literacy basics (KI-Kompetenz Basis): from 1,790 EUR net per team, half day, 10 people included, each additional person 90 EUR (up to 15).
- Copilot practice day (Copilot-Praxistag): from 2,900 EUR net per team, 1 day, 10 people included, each additional person 150 EUR (up to 12).
- AI agents and workflow automation course (KI-Agenten & Workflow-Automatisierung): from 5,900 EUR net per team, 2 days, 8 people included, each additional person 290 EUR (up to 10).

Funding: We check with you which funding fits your project.

## Method and tools
- Method: record the process, measure the starting point, pilot small, roll out, hand over (documentation and access belong to the client; source code for automations and internal tools).
- Tools: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate), Make, n8n, Python, custom code, CRM and ERP connections, EU hosting where required.
- Data protection (GDPR) is considered from the start; the final assessment belongs to your data protection officer or legal adviser.
- AI Act, Article 4: companies that use AI take measures to support their staff's AI literacy (applies since 2 February 2025; reworded by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force since 27 July 2026). No certificate is required; documented measures are good practice. We issue our own attendance certificate (Teilnahmebescheinigung).
